lang.5447a9cd4bdc2dbd208b4567 Description:
The Colt M4A1 carbine is a fully automatic variant of the basic M4 Carbine and was primarily designed for special operations use.
However, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) was soon to adopt the M4A1 for almost all special operations units, followed later by general introduction of the M4A1 into service with the U.S. Army and Marine Corps.
lang.55d4b9964bdc2d1d4e8b456e Description: The Colt A2 polymer pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 grips. Standard-issue for all AR-15-based weapons of US Army and USMC.
lang.55d4887d4bdc2d962f8b4570 Description:
A 30-round metal Colt AR-15 magazine designed in compliance with the STANAG 4179 standard for 5.56x45 ammo.
The STANAG 4179 standard was approved by NATO members in 1980 for the unification of allied personnel ammo and magazines.
lang.55d355e64bdc2d962f8b4569 Description: An upper receiver for the M4A1 assault rifle manufactured by Colt. Equipped with a mount for attaching additional devices.
lang.55d3632e4bdc2d972f8b4569 Description: A 14.5 inch (370mm) barrel for AR-15 platform weapons for 5.56x45 NATO ammo. Corresponds with standard service M4A1 barrel.
lang.544a38634bdc2d58388b4568 Name: AR-15 Colt USGI A2 5.56x45 flash hider
lang.544a38634bdc2d58388b4568 Description: The 5.56x45 Colt USGI A2 flash hider (a.k.a. Bird Cage) is designed for mounting on 5.56x45 weapons built on the AR-15 system. However, it can be installed on other weapons of the same caliber provided that barrel has the same threading for muzzle devices. A service muzzle device for M4A1.
lang.5ae30e795acfc408fb139a0b Name: M4A1 front sight with gas block
lang.5ae30e795acfc408fb139a0b Description: A standard-issue front sight with gas block for M4A1 assault rifles, manufactured by Colt.
lang.5ae30db85acfc408fb139a05 Name: AR-15 Colt M4 Carbine Length handguard
lang.5ae30db85acfc408fb139a05 Description: A carbine length handguard manufactured by Colt, a standard-issue handguard for the M4A1 assault rifles.
lang.637f57a68d137b27f70c4968 Name: AR-15 Colt M4 Carbine Length lower handguard
lang.637f57a68d137b27f70c4968 Description: A carbine length lower handguard part manufactured by Colt, a standard-issue handguard for the M4A1 assault rifles.
lang.5ae30bad5acfc400185c2dc4 Description: A detachable carry handle with a rear sight for AR-15 rifles. Standard-issue for M4A1 assault rifles.
lang.5649be884bdc2d79388b4577 Description: Colt Receiver Extension Buffer Tube, 4-position, Mil-Spec diameter will fit any AR-15-based carbine.
lang.55d4ae6c4bdc2d8b2f8b456e Description: The High Standard M4SS telescoping stock closely follows the classic M4A1 stock except for a few geometry details.
lang.55d44fd14bdc2d962f8b456e Description: A standard charging handle for AR-15 and compatible systems, manufactured by Colt.
lang.5c0c1d6586f7743e5335d264 Name: Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle Default
lang.5bfea6e90db834001b7347f3 Description: The Remington Model 700 is a series of bolt-action centerfire rifles manufactured by Remington Arms since 1962.
lang.5bfea7ad0db834001c38f1ee Description: A Remington M700 sniper rifle 5-round magazine by Wyatt's Outdoor, for 7.62x51 cartridges.
lang.5bfeb32b0db834001a6694d9 Description: The Overmolded Ghillie stock for the Remington Model 700 bolt-action sniper rifle. Manufactured by Hogue.
lang.5bfebc320db8340019668d79 Description: A 20 inch (508mm) threaded barrel for Remington Model 700 sniper rifle chambered in 7.62x51 NATO ammo.
lang.5d270b3c8abbc3105335cfb8 Description: A threading protection cap for the Remington M700 7.62x51 sniper rifle barrels.
lang.5d38517786f7742a1468cf6a Name: Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle MRS
lang.5d25a6538abbc306c62e630d Description: A 10-round Remington M700 sniper rifle magazine by Accuracy International, for 7.62x51 cartridges.
lang.5cde739cd7f00c0010373bd3 Name: M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 chassis
lang.5cde739cd7f00c0010373bd3 Description: The AB Arms MOD*X GEN III Modular Rifle System is a lightweight, ergonomic, drop-in chassis designed for the Remington Model 700 bolt-action sniper rifle.
lang.5a33ca0fc4a282000d72292f Description: A mil-spec rifle length Magpul Receiver Extension buffer tube, will fit any AR-15-based carbine or rifle.
lang.5a33cae9c4a28232980eb086 Description: The PRS GEN2 stock manufactured by Magpul. Flat Dark Earth version.
lang.5a339805c4a2826c6e06d73d Description: The Magpul MIAD (Mission Adaptable) polymer pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 grips. Flat Dark Earth version.
lang.5cde7afdd7f00c000d36b89d Name: M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 KeyMod handguard
lang.5cde7afdd7f00c000d36b89d Description: The AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 KeyMod handguard for M700 sniper rifles equipped with a KeyMod interface for installation of additional devices and accessories.
lang.5a9d6d00a2750c5c985b5305 Description: The Strike Industries 4 inch rail for KeyMod systems allows installation of additional equipment on the handguards equipped with a standard KeyMod interface.
lang.5a9d6d13a2750c00164f6b03 Description: The Strike Industries 6 inch rail for KeyMod systems allows installation of additional equipment on the handguards equipped with a standard KeyMod interface.
lang.5cde7b43d7f00c000d36b93e Name: M700 AB Arms MOD*X rail mount
lang.5cde7b43d7f00c000d36b93e Description: The AB Arms MOD*X universal mount for the Remington Model 700 sniper rifle, allows installation of various optics.
lang.59d6088586f774275f37482f Description: The AKM (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny - Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Modernised) 7.62x39mm automatic rifle was adopted in 1959 to replace AK as a standard service weapon of the Soviet Army. Main differences compared to AK: enhanced accuracy range, lower weight, new stock, trigger, hammer retarder, muzzle compensator, and other design changes aimed at improving the efficiency of the rifle.
lang.59d64ec286f774171d1e0a42 Description: A standard 6P1 Sb.1-2 gas tube for AKM automatic rifles. Gas tubes channel the travel direction of gas piston.
lang.59d64f2f86f77417193ef8b3 Description: A standard Izhmash-produced 6P1 Sb.6-1 wooden AKM handguard.
lang.59d64fc686f774171b243fe2 Description: A standard Izhmash-produced 6P1 0-14 muzzle brake-compensator for AKM automatic rifles and weapon systems based on it.
lang.59e62cc886f77440d40b52a1 Description: A bakelite Izhmash-manufactured pistol grip for AKM automatic rifles.
lang.59d6507c86f7741b846413a2 Description: A standard-issue 6P1 0-1 dust cover for AKM automatic rifles, manufactured by Izhmash.
lang.59d650cf86f7741b846413a4 Description: A standard 6P1 Sb.2-1 rear sight for AKM automatic rifles, manufactured by Izhmash.
lang.59d6514b86f774171a068a08 Description: A standard-issue wooden 6P1 Sb.5 stock for AKM automatic rifles, manufactured by Izhmash.
lang.59d625f086f774661516605d Description: A standard 30-round metal magazine for 7.62x39 AK and compatible weapons from 1955 onward. Can also be supplied with .366 TKM ammo for use with the corresponding caliber AK-compatible weapons.
lang.61a4c8884f95bc3b2c5dc96f Description: The Rhino revolvers, manufactured by the Italian company Armi Chiappa, are distinguished by a revolutionary patented design and construction with an unusual barrel arrangement for revolvers opposite the lower drum chamber.
lang.619f54a1d25cbd424731fb99 Description: A 6-round .357 cylinder for Chiappa Rhino revolvers.

lang.619f4d304c58466fe1228437 Description: A standard-issue front sight for Rhino revolvers, manufactured by Chiappa Firearms.
lang.619f4bffd25cbd424731fb97 Description: A wooden pistol grip for Rhino revolvers, manufactured by Chiappa Firearms.
